narrative: On the board. A foul leaf on the desk. One line is struck through with a single stroke. The rest of the leaf is blank. His right hand is at the edge, a little ink on the forefinger. His face is not over the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the struck line and did not add another.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on draft in Where the note stops
